Every animal rescued!

Camel to the desert, polar bear to the ice, frog to the pond, monkey to the rainforest!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Habitat matching builds empathy plus geography: ask what would happen if the polar bear swapped with the camel. The giggles carry the learning.
